text: On the ethics_justice testbed, we evaluated early stopping on weak-label validation loss with an early_stop_patience of 3, aggregating over num_seeds = 10 seeds. The method attained a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.58 with a standard error of 0.13, indicating that the student recovers somewhat more than half of the gap between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling, but with substantial seed-to-seed spread: the standard error of 0.13 means a two-standard-error interval spans a wide range of plausible values. Importantly, no baseline PGR was supplied in this experiment, so this number cannot be characterized as an improvement over, or a regression from, any alternative stopping criterion or unmodified training run; it stands only as a standalone measurement. Interpretation is further limited to this single testbed and this single patience setting, so no claim is made about transfer to other task domains, patience values, or weak-supervisor strengths. Comparative runs with a declared baseline would be needed to assess relative benefit.
